# teams agent create

Create an Agent 365 agent identity

## Usage

```
teams agent create [name] [options]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description | Required |
|----------|-------------|----------|
| `name` | Agent name | No |

## Options

| Flag | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `--m365` | [OPTIONAL] Register the messaging endpoint for Teams/Copilot (M365 agent) |
| `--aiteammate` | [OPTIONAL] Create an Agentic User (AI teammate) so the agent can be installed and used from Teams/Copilot, instead of an identity-only blueprint agent |
| `--json` | [OPTIONAL] Output as JSON |
<!-- AUTOGENERATED:END -->

## Details

Creates an [Microsoft Agent 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-agent-365/developer/registration) agent identity in a single command: it detects (and, with confirmation, installs) the [Agent 365 CLI](https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-agent-365/developer/agent-365-cli) .NET global tool, verifies your Azure CLI and Teams login are on the same tenant, then runs `a365 setup all` to provision the agent blueprint, managed identity, and (optionally) a messaging endpoint.

> **Blueprint vs. Agentic User:** by default this creates an identity-only **agent blueprint** — it registers the agent identity but does **not** create an account that can be installed or used from Teams/Copilot. Pass `--aiteammate` to additionally create an **Agentic User** (AI teammate account), which is required before the agent can show up in the Teams app store, Microsoft 365 Copilot, or Copilot Studio. `teams app create --agent` always passes `--aiteammate` for this reason, since it's building a Teams app.

### Prerequisites

- Logged in: `teams login`
- [.NET 8+](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download) installed (required to run the Agent 365 CLI)
- Signed in to the same tenant with the Azure CLI (`az login`) as with `teams login`
- Sufficient Entra permissions to create an agent blueprint (Global Administrator recommended; see [Admin Consent](#admin-consent) below if you're not one)

### Examples

Create interactively (prompts for an agent name if not provided):

```bash
teams agent create
```

Create a named agent identity:

```bash
teams agent create "My Support Agent"
```

Create and register a messaging endpoint for Teams/Copilot:

```bash
teams agent create "My Support Agent" --m365
```

Create an Agentic User (AI teammate) that can be installed/used from Teams or Copilot:

```bash
teams agent create "My Support Agent" --m365 --aiteammate
```

Machine-readable output for CI/agent use:

```bash
teams agent create "My Support Agent" --json --yes
```

### Admin Consent

If you aren't a Global Administrator, `a365 setup all` may finish without granting the required OAuth2 permission consents. In that case `teams agent create` still exits successfully and reports `status: "pending_admin_consent"`, printing a consent URL (when available) that a Global Administrator can use to finish granting permissions. Re-run `teams agent create` after consent is granted to confirm `status: "completed"`.

### Output

On success (human mode), outputs the agent blueprint ID, managed identity principal ID, messaging endpoint (if `--m365`), and the path to the generated `a365.generated.config.json`. With `--json`, outputs an object shaped like:

```json
{
  "status": "completed",
  "agentBlueprintId": "...",
  "agentBlueprintObjectId": "...",
  "managedIdentityPrincipalId": "...",
  "generatedConfigPath": "/path/to/a365.generated.config.json"
}
```

### Scope

This command covers the two most common paths: creating a standard identity-only agent blueprint, or (with `--aiteammate`) an Agentic User that can actually be installed and used from Teams/Copilot. It does not yet cover custom Azure infrastructure options (SKU/region) or GCC/GCC-High/DoD clouds. See the [design doc](https://github.com/microsoft/teams-sdk/blob/main/packages/cli/docs/designs/agent-identity-design.md) for the full rationale and rollout plan.
